title: Version 1.30.0
body:
Version 1.30.0

July 26th, 2023

Added:

  • Added THE GRABBIEST GRABBER!
  • Water now waves up and down, including boxed water
  • The inventory can now have their tools moved around by dragging

Changed:

  • Both new variants of Stud Cactus' sell price has been increased
  • Rusty Refinery and Rusty Chisel have been placed back on the default shelves
  • Changed material of water to be better than smooth plastic
  • Rewrote grabby grabber to be more performant and work on mobile
  • Shutdown indicator now shows when driving

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue which prevented 2/3 of the new Stud shop items from appearing (sorry)
  • Fixed spawn locations not working when loading property
